tweetText: OpenAI is testing ads within ChatGPT to help keep the service free. This move helps fund development while keeping user data private. via OpenAI News
OpenAI and AWS are bringing Daybreak cybersecurity tools to Amazon Bedrock. This makes it easier for businesses to secure their AI workflows. via OpenAI News
OpenAI launched a new ChatGPT desktop app for Linux users. This makes it much easier for developers and power users to access AI directly from their workflow. via TechCrunch AI
Google's Gemini app has reached 1 billion users. This massive growth shows how much people rely on AI for voice chat and image generation. via TechCrunch AI
OpenAI COO Brad Lightcap is leaving the company to start a new venture. This departure marks a major leadership shift at the AI giant. via TechCrunch AI
River AI just raised $1.1 billion to build personal AI agents. This massive funding for a two-month-old startup shows how much investors are betting on the future of AI assistants. via TechCrunch AI
Anthropic's unreleased AI model made significant progress on the unsolved Riemann hypothesis. This shows AI is becoming a powerful tool for solving complex mathematical mysteries. via TechCrunch AI
Spotify is labeling AI-generated artist profiles and excluding their music from recommendations. This could reshape how AI-generated content is treated on major platforms. via TechCrunch AI
Anthropic is adding watermarking to its AI models. This helps identify AI-generated text to prevent misuse. via TechCrunch AI
A Zoom bug allowed hackers to hijack devices during screen-sharing sessions. This shows how quickly AI can find new security flaws. via WIRED AI
